# ConPTY interop surface, source-generated by CsWin32 into the partial
# NativeMethods class (see csproj: Microsoft.Windows.CsWin32, Windows-only).
# Everything here is generated as [LibraryImport] externs (build-task mode).
#
# Note: PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_PSEUDOCONSOLE (0x20016) is NOT in the CsWin32
# metadata (it is a Win10 1809+ feature); WindowsPty.cs defines it as a custom
# constant, same value used by Microsoft's ConPTY samples.

# Pseudo console lifecycle
CreatePseudoConsole
ResizePseudoConsole
ClosePseudoConsole

# Pipe plumbing for the ConPTY input/output channels (anonymous pipes:
# inputRead + outputWrite go to the pseudo console; we keep inputWrite +
# outputRead).
CreatePipe

# Synchronous I/O on the ConPTY pipe handles (ConPTY does not support
# overlapped I/O, so these are plain blocking reads/writes).
ReadFile
WriteFile

# Process spawn with the pseudoconsole attribute attached
CreateProcessW
InitializeProcThreadAttributeList
UpdateProcThreadAttribute
DeleteProcThreadAttributeList
STARTUPINFOEXW
PROCESS_INFORMATION

# Process handle / exit code (reaper, Kill)
GetExitCodeProcess
TerminateProcess
WaitForSingleObject

# ConPTY availability check (Windows 10 1809+)
LoadLibrary
GetProcAddress
